title: Central Limit Theorems for Outcome Records in Disordered Quantum Trajectories
summary: We prove annealed functional central limit theorems for finite pattern counts in the measurement record of discrete-time quantum trajectories, with the instrument applied at each step determined by an invertible, probability-preserving base dynamical system. When the base is ergodic, under summable strong-mixing coefficients of the instrument process and a summable uniform annealed trace-norm forgetting rate for the associated non-selective channel cocycle, we establish a joint functional CLT for bounded vector-valued functions of finite outcome blocks under the annealed law determined by…
